camel_example: aliyun gpdb ListBranches --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --PageNumber 1 --ParentBranchId 'br-main' --SortBy CreateTime --Search main --MaxResults 20 --SortOrder Desc --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Queries the branch list of a Supabase project
description_zh: 查询 Supabase 项目的分支列表
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb list-branches --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --parent-branch-id br-main --search main --sort-by CreateTime --sort-order Desc --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --max-results 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBranches

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a sub-branch, the region is inherited from the primary branch by default
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。创建主分支时必须指定，创建子分支时默认继承主分支所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of records per page.

Valid values:
10
20
50
100

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。

可选值：
10
20
50
100

默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。取值需大于 0，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The parent branch ID. Specifies the parent branch for a new branch or as a query filter condition
parameters.help_zh: 父分支 ID，用于指定新分支或查询条件的上级分支
parameters.name: parent_branch_id

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Supports fuzzy search by branch ID or branch name
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键字。支持按分支 ID 或分支名称模糊搜索
parameters.name: search

parameters.help_en:
The sort field.

Valid values:
BranchName: sorts by branch name.
CreateTime: sorts by creation time.
LastRunTime: sorts by last run time.

Default value: CreateTime
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。

可选值：
BranchName：按分支名称排序。
CreateTime：按创建时间排序。
LastRunTime：按最近运行时间排序。

默认值：CreateTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction.

Valid values:
Asc: ascending order.
Desc: descending order.

Default value: Desc
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。

可选值：
Asc：升序。
Desc：降序。

默认值：Desc
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The cursor for paging query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的游标。首次查询无需传入，后续查询使用上一次返回的 NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in this query
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

Branch.description_en: The branch list. Each element represents a Supabase branch
Branch.description_zh: 分支列表。每个元素表示一个 Supabase 分支

BranchId.description_en: The branch ID, which uniquely identifies a Supabase branch
BranchId.description_zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支

CreateTime.description_en: The branch creation time in ISO 8601 UTC format
CreateTime.description_zh: 分支创建时间，格式为 ISO 8601 UTC 时间

ExpiresAt.description_en: The time when the branch automatically expires and is deleted, in ISO 8601 UTC format
ExpiresAt.description_zh: 分支过期自动删除时间，格式为 ISO 8601 UTC 时间

InitSource.description_en:
The branch initialization source.

Valid values:
ParentData: Copies the schema and data from the parent branch. This is the default value.
SchemaOnly: Copies only the schema structure
InitSource.description_zh:
分支初始化来源。

取值：
ParentData：复制父分支的 Schema 和数据，默认值。
SchemaOnly：仅复制 Schema 结构

IsDefault.description_en: Indicates whether this is the default branch

ParentBranchId.description_en: The parent branch ID. Specifies the parent branch for a new branch or as a query filter condition
ParentBranchId.description_zh: 父分支 ID，用于指定新分支或查询条件的上级分支

ParentBranchName.description_en: The parent branch name. This value is empty or displayed as - for the primary branch
ParentBranchName.description_zh: 父分支名称。主分支为空或显示为 -

ParentLSN.description_en: The LSN of the parent branch at the time this branch was created
ParentLSN.description_zh: 该分支创建时对应父分支的 LSN

ParentTimestamp.description_en:
The data synchronization point in time selected from the parent branch when this branch was created, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

Note:
For sub-branches, this value indicates the parent branch point in time selected during creation.
If no parent branch exists, the value is 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
ParentTimestamp.description_zh:
该分支从父分支创建时选择的数据同步时间点，格式为 ISO 8601 UTC 时间。

说明：
子分支返回创建时选择的父分支时间点。
无父分支时返回 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z

ProjectId.description_en: The Supabase project ID that corresponds to the primary branch
ProjectId.description_zh: 主分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID

Protected.description_en:
Indicates whether branch protection is enabled.

Valid values:
true: Branch protection is enabled.
false: Branch protection is disabled
Protected.description_zh:
是否开启分支保护。

取值：
true：开启分支保护。
false：关闭分支保护

ServiceType.description_en:
The service type.

Valid values:
Supabase: Supabase service.
Memory: Memory service
ServiceType.description_zh:
服务类型。

可选值：
Supabase：Supabase 服务。
Memory：Memory 服务

SpbProjectId.description_en: The Supabase project ID that corresponds to the current branch
SpbProjectId.description_zh: 当前分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records to return in this query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询返回的最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: The cursor for paging query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
NextToken.description_zh: 分页查询的游标。首次查询无需传入，后续查询使用上一次返回的 NextToken

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 页码。取值需大于 0，默认值为 1

PageSize.description_en:
The number of records per page.

Valid values:
10
20
50
100

Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh:
每页记录数。

可选值：
10
20
50
100

默认值：20

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of branches that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的分支总数
